reason: My customers already find me on my weekend Facebook lives and message me on WhatsApp, which costs nothing. I'm not going to pay per message and set up a sender name for something my nephew already does for free.
objection: WhatsApp and Facebook are free and my customers actually reply there. An SMS just sits next to bank OTPs, and I can't see it bringing anyone into the shop.
would_change_my_mind: If whoever runs my marketing showed me that one SMS blast for a sale brought in clearly more customers or orders than our WhatsApp posts did, with the cost worked out for my list size.
